cohort: Mothers affected by umbilical cord prolapse from April 2014 to March 2016 at a hospital in South India.
finding: The incidence of umbilical cord prolapse was 0.1%, and neonatal outcomes were generally good, with low rates of birth injuries and the majority of babies having APGAR scores >=7 at 5 minutes.
mod_finding: 95% of babies were delivered by lower segment cesarean section (LSCS).
